title: 'Why Waste Money?' Karnataka High Court Questions SEC's 'Parallel' Electoral Roll Revision Amid ECI's Ongoing SIR Exercise
description: The Karnataka High Court on Monday (July 20) questioned the State Election Commission's (SEC) decision to undertake a separate Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in certain wards falling under the Mahadevapura Assembly Constituency when the Election Commission of India (ECI) is already carrying out its nationwide SIR Phase III exercise in Karnataka.
